description: Original RSAT controls. Applicability depends on device role; no compliance certification is implied.

rules.title: BitLocker protection active on every fixed volume
rules.remediation: Resume BitLocker protection after confirming firmware/update work is complete. Inspect every fixed volume.

rules.title: BitLocker fixed volumes fully encrypted
rules.remediation: Enable BitLocker on applicable fixed volumes and allow encryption to complete.

rules.title: BitLocker key protectors configured
rules.remediation: Configure approved key protectors and verify recovery arrangements without exporting recovery secrets.

rules.title: FileVault enabled
rules.remediation: Enable FileVault in System Settings and verify recovery arrangements.

rules.title: Every Windows firewall profile enabled
rules.remediation: Enable Domain, Private and Public firewall profiles through the owning local or central policy.

rules.title: Windows default inbound traffic blocked
rules.remediation: Set default inbound traffic to Block for every profile; review allowed services.

rules.title: Windows blocked traffic logging enabled
rules.remediation: Enable blocked traffic logging with appropriate retention and access controls.

rules.title: macOS application firewall enabled
rules.remediation: Enable the macOS application firewall.

rules.title: macOS firewall stealth mode enabled
rules.remediation: Enable stealth mode if compatible with the device role.

rules.title: Linux nftables input policy drops by default
rules.remediation: Configure an appropriate nftables input policy, preserving authorized access. Other backends require separate evidence.

rules.title: Antivirus enabled
rules.remediation: Verify the approved endpoint protection product and its effective policy. If another product is installed, document supporting evidence and an exception.

rules.title: Real-time protection enabled
rules.remediation: Verify the approved endpoint protection product and its effective policy. If another product is installed, document supporting evidence and an exception.

rules.title: Behavior monitoring enabled
rules.remediation: Verify the approved endpoint protection product and its effective policy. If another product is installed, document supporting evidence and an exception.

rules.title: Tamper protection enabled
rules.remediation: Verify the approved endpoint protection product and its effective policy. If another product is installed, document supporting evidence and an exception.

rules.title: Defender signatures no more than two days old
rules.remediation: Refresh antivirus signatures and check update connectivity.

rules.title: Secure Boot enabled
rules.remediation: Check platform support and enable Secure Boot using vendor procedures. Preserve boot recovery access.

rules.title: TPM present
rules.remediation: Verify that a supported TPM is available and enabled. Do not clear the TPM without recovery planning.

rules.title: TPM ready
rules.remediation: Investigate TPM readiness using vendor guidance; preserve encryption recovery access.

rules.title: Virtualization-based security running
rules.remediation: Evaluate device compatibility and enable virtualization-based security under the approved baseline.

rules.title: macOS System Integrity Protection enabled
rules.remediation: Re-enable System Integrity Protection using Apple recovery procedures after checking device requirements.

rules.title: macOS authenticated root enabled
rules.remediation: Restore authenticated-root protection using supported Apple recovery procedures.

rules.title: macOS Gatekeeper enabled
rules.remediation: Enable Gatekeeper assessment and investigate why it was disabled.

rules.title: RDP requires Network Level Authentication
rules.remediation: Require Network Level Authentication where RDP is permitted. Restrict network access separately.

rules.title: SMBv1 disabled
rules.remediation: Disable SMBv1 after checking legacy dependencies.

rules.title: SMB server signing required
rules.remediation: Require SMB signing after validating compatibility and central policy.

rules.title: macOS remote login disabled
rules.remediation: Disable remote login when unnecessary; otherwise document the approved role and SSH controls.

rules.title: Linux direct root SSH login disabled
rules.remediation: Set PermitRootLogin no and validate sshd configuration and recovery access before reloading.

rules.title: Linux SSH password authentication disabled
rules.remediation: Use managed SSH keys or an approved alternative; confirm access before disabling password authentication.

rules.title: Windows guest account disabled
rules.remediation: Disable the local guest account.

rules.title: User Account Control enabled
rules.remediation: Enable UAC in the approved local or central policy.

rules.title: UAC prompts administrators
rules.remediation: Configure administrator consent prompts according to the approved baseline.

rules.title: macOS guest account disabled
rules.remediation: Disable guest login unless specifically required and approved.

rules.title: Only root has Linux UID zero
rules.remediation: Investigate unexpected UID-zero accounts before changing identity configuration.

rules.title: No pending reboot indicator
rules.remediation: Schedule a reboot if required. This control does not establish patch currency.

rules.title: Live update search reports no available updates
rules.remediation: Review and install applicable vendor updates. The result reflects the configured update source at the recorded search time.

rules.title: Windows automatic update policy does not disable updates
rules.remediation: Ensure effective update management is enabled. An absent policy requires separate evidence.

rules.title: macOS automatic update schedule enabled
rules.remediation: Enable the automatic software update schedule or document equivalent managed update controls.

rules.title: Linux automatic update timer present
rules.remediation: Configure distribution-supported automatic update scheduling or document an equivalent managed process.

rules.title: Linux audit service active
rules.remediation: Install and configure auditd when required by the device baseline.

rules.title: Recent macOS backup evidence
rules.remediation: Verify a recent backup and perform a separate restoration test; a backup timestamp alone does not prove recovery.

rules.title: Backup restoration independently tested
rules.remediation: Attach independent evidence of a successful restoration test; endpoint configuration alone is insufficient.

rules.title: macOS enrolled in device management
rules.remediation: For managed business devices, enroll through the authorized organization. Personal devices may need a documented exception.
